title: Brawl Stars teams with skateboard designer Bear Walker to commemorate Tokyo Finals
summary: The 2026 Brawl Stars World Finals, which took place this past week in Tokyo, Japan, already stood out for its exotic location. But it's not just the place that's catching people's eye, as Supercell have also teamed up with skateboard designer Bear Walker to commemorate the occasion with a brand-new deck! While those attending the Brawl Stars World Finals in Tokyo will have been in with a chance to buy one of a thousand limited-edition Melted Spike decks, now those of you who didn't get the chance can try to nab the Sakura Spike street deck instead! Designed around fan-favourite character Spike, and the iconic cherry blossom trees of Japan, this deck is only available to buy until November 29th! ... [MORE]

title: Monopoly Go says Avengers Assemble with new Doomsday collaboration starting this week
summary: Monopoly Go has hosted some major names in pop culture for collabs over the years, ranging from K-pop Demon Hunters to The Simpsons. Now, however, they're teaming up with what could be their biggest partnership yet, as Marvel Studios' Avengers: Doomsday arrives on the board starting November 25th! The Avengers: Doomsday x Monopoly Go collab runs from November 25th all the way to January 27th, and sees you opposing the machinations of Doctor Doom. You'll traverse the masked tyrant's homeland of Latveria in the Doomstadt map, as well as take on the Doomsy in an all-new hero battle. ... [MORE]

title: Raid: Shadow Legends lets you know what is best in life with its Conan the Barbarian collaboration
summary: For whatever reason, Robert E. Howard's Conan has come back into vogue for mobile publishers recently. First, UnGodly saw the original Conan announced, and now Raid: Shadow Legends has kicked off its own collab featuring none other than Schwarzenegger's interpretation of Conan the Barbarian from 1982. Kicking off today and running through February 23rd, Raid: Shadow Legends' Conan the Barbarian collaboration features Conan himself, of course. But you can also claim Valeria, the heroic swordswoman who accompanies Conan in the film, as a free character just for logging in to add a bit of Hyborian flair to your roster. ... [MORE]

title: Suits & Stallions is a classy little party game that lets you race horses, now on iOS and Android
summary: When it comes to 'classy' party games, I'd be hard-pressed to think of any. By their very nature, most party games are lighthearted and fun, but that's where Suits & Stallions comes in: a new entry in the genre available now on iOS and Android that leans into the classier side of the equation. What's the classiest thing you can imagine? Horse racing, of course! And that's what Suits & Stallions is all about, as you race your porcelain model horses across a board in a classily lit museum setting. Each card you draw can move either you, your opponent or both, depending on the corresponding suit, but you can try to nudge the results or whip your chosen stallion into shape for a better chance at success. ... [MORE]

title: Gunboat God offers blazingly fast, inky black bullet hell action for you on iOS and Android
summary: Nowadays, with the popularity of Vampire Survivors, it seems as though the humble bullet hell has become somewhat passe in the face of the bullet heaven. But Gunboat God, now available on iOS and Android, may just prove that the bullet hell genre isn't dead by a long shot! Gunboat God is an inky black-and-white take on the bullet hell and shoot-em-up genre, where your only aim is to slay as many enemies as possible and make your way back to the Citadel in the sky. Along the way, you'll fly into the air, dive beneath the waves and skirt along the surface, blasting foes to bits as you go. ... [MORE]

title: Ember Outpost offers the Rimworld experience on mobile, out now for iOS and Android
summary: Space, the final frontier. And like all frontiers, there's always someone willing to take a chance on building a new life there, no matter how much of a ludicrously ill-advised idea it may be. It's a concept that offers rich ground for colony management sims, but there haven't been many options for that on mobile, well, until Ember Outpost arrived. Available now on iOS and Android, Ember Outpost is a colony management sim that sees you guiding a group of settlers on an alien world. Everything, from food to water and other supplies, will need to be crafted or collected, and you'll also have to deal with the drastically contradictory personalities of your colonists. Oh, and let's add natural disasters and murderous raiders, just for some extra spice. ... [MORE]

title: Arknights: Endfield gets trippy in the World O'Shrooms update
summary: I wouldn't really call Arknights: Endfield an envelope-pusher of a game, as it mainly plays to the same tried-and-true tropes we associate with anime-inspired ARPGs. But it seems the folks at Gryphline have read my mind, and now have their kookiest update yet about to land with the launch of Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms. Landing November 25th, World o'Shrooms looks to be a refreshing change of pace from what Arknights: Endfield has been doing previously. In this storyline, an abandoned dam outside the city of Wuling is now playing host to a cult of mushroom worshippers and an outbreak of giant, psychoactive fungi. ... [MORE]

title: Mixcity Swap is an upcoming card battler that promises you it's the anti gacha
summary: Whenever I mention that I write about mobile gaming, the inevitable first response from laymen and industry people alike is, 'Well, that's all just gacha, right?' And on the one hand, they're not necessarily right, but not wrong either. The random draw system is so pervasive that even many developers pit themselves against it, like with the upcoming Mixcity Swap. Positioning itself as the anti-gacha, Mixcity Swap is an upcoming sports-themed card battler by Atypique Studio, releasing in 2027 for iOS and Android, that sees you taking on fast-paced, 10-minute matches. With only nine cards on the roster, the gameplay revolves around swapping in and out your athletes across different modes, doing so at the right interval as they activate their individual effects. ... [MORE]

title: Cell to Singularity's Future update takes you into space for a new look at humanity's progress
summary: There's an odd fascination amongst developers for trying to simulate the progression of humanity. Surviving Mars, Alpha Centauri and, of course, Civilization. But in Cell to Singularity, developer Computer Lunch has been working towards a simulation of everything, with the latest major step being their Future update. Cell to Singularity is, essentially, exactly what it says on the tin. Your goal is to explore and guide a simulation of an entire human civilisation, starting from simple single-celled organisms all the way up to the space-faring apes we all know and love. And the Future expansion, naturally, takes you into the speculative future of space travel and beyond. ... [MORE]

title: Postal Classic & Uncut brings the dark, violent classic shooter to Android
summary: There are plenty of controversial game franchises out there. But many are pretty lazy, and either intentionally racist, sexist or simply provocative. A truly controversial series is one that sets out to do something, and does so in an unapologetic and probably disturbing way. In unrelated news, Running With Scissors' Postal Classic & Uncut is out now on Google Play! Unlike, say, Postal II, there's no wackiness or crass humour here. The story is simple: You are the Dude, and everybody else has to die. That means blasting your way through dozens of levels ranging from suburban neighbourhoods to downtown metropolises, with a variety of firearms and explosives, as you face down police officers, armed residents and plenty of unarmed civilians caught in the crossfire. ... [MORE]

summary: It seems as though it's been a while since we wrote about the Epic Games Store on mobile. But in the background, the House of Sweeney has been quietly chugging along with its free game promotions. In Lonesome Village, you play a lone coyote visiting the titular place, which is now bereft of its inhabitants. title: Leingham Tavern Story has you turning dungeon crawling into a restaurant business
summary: In an RPG, you’d expect to become stronger by hitting things, but in Kemco’s latest, you do it by eating your own cooking (abs are made in the kitchen, as the saying goes). Leingham Tavern Story: Alan and the Time Goddess is out now on the App Store and Google Play. It’s a dungeon crawler and a restaurant sim at the same time, and there’s an orphanage to save on top. That orphanage is the whole reason you’re doing any of this. It’s about to close down, and Alan and his mates reckon a busy tavern will make enough money to keep it going. Which means heading down into dungeons for ingredients. ... [MORE]

summary: Is being neutral easy? Not even slightly, because sometimes, not taking a position is the most telling of all. And in Suzerain Stories: The Neutral Lens, the upcoming release from Torpor Games, landing December 3rd, you'll find out just how tricky it is.  Whereas other entries in the Suzerain series saw you take control of the fate of a country and make high-level decisions, The Neutral Lens narrows the scale considerably. title: Monopoly Go introduces a new cooperative minigame that lets you and your friends build Paths
summary: Whether you like it or loathe it, there's no doubting the popularity and staying power of Monopoly Go for Scopely. Now, the hit tabletop-to-mobile adaptation is receiving an all-new minigame. Paths challenge you to think cooperatively, or look out for yourself, and debut today with the launch of the new Franken Paths as part of the Monster Mash season! Paths are a straightforward cooperative minigame where you and up to three other tycoons team up to build a path and move a shared vehicle along it. You'll accumulate points and have the choice to either use them to build your assigned portion (and reap the rewards) or send them to another player, with the aim of reaching the end together and getting even greater goodies. ... [MORE]

title: Talking Tom Gold Run raises the stakes in new all-or-nothing Extraction Mode
summary: It's all or nothing in Outfit7's latest update for Talking Tom Gold Run, where the concept of "high risk, high return" has never been truer! In particular, a new Extraction Mode within the endless runner tasks you with running faster and faster for better and better rewards - the catch is that when you crash and burn, so does your hard-earned haul. The limited-time event not only challenges your quick reflexes but also your prudence - do you go for the bigger pay-off or leave while you can with what you already have? She’ll help you uncover hidden items and hand out rewards of her own as well. That is, if she remembers. ... [MORE]

title: Dragon Ruins II offers you bare-bones, rock-hard dungeon-crawling action, now in pre-registration on Android
summary: Nowadays, the quintessential fun of a dungeon crawl is virtually unknown to the younger generation. What happened to the times when starving to death or getting lost forever was a very real occupational hazard for adventurers?! Well, that's what Dragon Ruins II seeks to recapture as it opens pre-registration on Android. As the sequel to the original Dragon Ruins, in Dragon Ruins II you'll return to the capital city of Isigwere, taking on quests from its inhabitants as you venture deeper into the dungeon. All with the ultimate aim of slaying the dragon that lurks therein and becoming the much-vaunted Legendary Hero. ... [MORE]
